    Module

    src/connector-ui/src/api

    Layer client · project connector-ui

    Project navigation: connector-ui

    Overview 🤖

    Contains API endpoints for various functionalities such as authentication, branding, connections, and export definitions.

    Responsibilities. Manages user authentication, branding configuration, connection management, and export definitions.

    Usage. Used by various components and views within the connector-ui project to interact with backend services.

    AI draft from the facts on this page; review it, then write the module's documentation yourself.

    revokeAllSessions Invalidates every JWT issued to the current user, including the one this request itself used — the caller must treat the local session as dead and re-login afterward regardless of whether this call succeeds or fails, since a network error here shouldn't block signing out locally. 1

    listImportDefinitions Returns all saved import definitions (summary rows, no RootNode/AllowedWritableColumns). 2
    getImportDefinition Returns one import definition including its full RootNode tree, or null if it doesn't exist. 2
    createImportDefinition Creates a new import definition. 1
    updateImportDefinition Validates and persists changes to an existing import definition. 1
    deleteImportDefinition Permanently deletes an import definition. 1
    duplicateImportDefinition Copies a definition's tree/allowlist into a new, disabled definition. 2
    setImportDefinitionEnabled Toggles IsEnabled without touching the rest of the definition — the list view's per-row switch. 1
    previewImportDefinition Parses + walks + plans a sample inbound file against a saved definition — no ImportRunEntity is created and nothing is written to the ERP. 1
    suggestImportMappingFromExport Checks whether a pasted sample ImportEnvelope's provenance pair matches a known, provenance-tagged export — the "Create from export" suggestion the New Import Definition flow offers. Returns null for anything short of an exact match (malformed JSON, no provenance, no match) or a network failure; the caller must render both the same way, never as an error. 3
    stageImportDefinitionRun Stages an operator-selected file as a real run (PendingReview), the same way the inbound/ folder watcher would — unlike preview, this persists and shows up in run history / the review dialog. 1
    listImportDefinitionRuns Execution history for a definition, most recent first. 2
    getImportRun Full detail for one run — counts plus the plan operations — for the review/diff dialog. 2
    releaseImportRun Four-eyes commit: applies every matched/changed row still valid at commit time. 1
    rejectImportRun Declines a pending run without writing anything to the ERP — single-person, no Approver needed. 1

    ImportMappingSuggestionCandidateField

    interface · importDefinitions.ts

    One best-effort candidate field alongside the deterministic root prefill — unchecked by default; the operator must explicitly enable it before it can ever be saved as writable.

    ImportMappingSuggestionCheckResult

    interface · importDefinitions.ts

    Response of POST /api/import-definitions/suggest-from-export. Exactly one of suggestion/reason is set: a hit carries suggestion with reason null; a miss carries a null suggestion with an operator-facing explanation of which gate stopped it (no provenance in the pasted sample, no export tagged with that key/version, one tagged but disabled, or one tagged and enabled but missing its Correlation key field) — never a flat, unexplained "no match."
